messages:
Jared: Quick thread to capture follow-ups from today's all-hands finance segment. Ask questions and we'll answer.
Devon: Can you restate the current burn and runway in simple terms?
Maya: Burn ~ $3.2M/month. Cash + committed revenue gives ~18 months runway under base plan.
Ravi: If bookings slip 20% what happens to runway?
Maya: If bookings are down 20% and we don't cut spend, runway drops to ~13 months. With targeted actions we can get back to ~16 months.
Priya: What are the targeted actions?
Maya: Short-term: selective hiring pause, reduce nonessential marketing, renegotiate large vendor contracts, and tighten procurement thresholds.
Devon: Hiring pause: is it company-wide?
Jared: Selective. Critical infra, on-call, and key customer roles continue. Other reqs need VP + Finance signoff.
Priya: Procurement thresholds?
ProcurementBot: New policy effective today: purchases > $5k require Finance review; > $25k require Legal + CFO approval. Auto-hold on renewals > $10k. Submit via https://redwood.internal/procure.
Ravi: SLA for approvals? previous requests were slow.
ProcurementBot: Target SLAs: <$5k: 2 business days; $5k-25k: 5 business days; >25k: 10 business days. Use "expedite" tag for customer-impacting items.
Devon: Any capex plan for GPUs to lower opex?
Maya: We're evaluating capped on-prem purchases for dedicated pools. Any > $200k goes through ROI review and board notice.
Priya: Will compensation or quotas change?
Jared: No changes to comp or quotas today. We want to avoid comp actions.
Ravi: Exception process for urgent >$25k spend?
Maya: Open procurement ticket, tag @Jared + @Maya, include customer impact and rollback plan. We'll triage within 24 hours for true customer-impacting cases.
Devon: Thanks, helpful.
Jared: We'll post the updated approval matrix and a short FAQ to #finance-docs and the all-hands notes. DM leadership for one-off concerns. Closing this thread.
